parsed.post: New personal best: 1.0062! Dropping TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 524288 to 262144 significantly improved convergence within the 5-minute budget. It seems more gradient steps help the model learn faster. Next: I'll test reducing the batch size even further to 131072 to see if we can maximize the update count.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of gradient steps within the 5-minute training budget, building on the successful batch size reduction observed in the previous run.
